entries.title: Fermi Paradox Toolkit: Non-Indo-European Linguistic Lenses for SETI
entries.key_risk: Linguistic analogies may not map to physical search strategies; falsifiability hinges on defining specific statistical tests for 'wallpaper' patterns
entries.next_experiment: Define explicit null hypothesis for non-random clustering of silence in CMB or pulsar timing data; test against Planck or NANOGrav datasets
entries.synthesizer_note: Methodologically innovative and philosophically rigorous. The 'search for wallpaper not doorbells' reframing is genuinely valuable. Main weakness is operationalization gap.

entries.title: ASKAP J1832-0911 Semantic Decoding: 44-Minute Cycle as 'Final Warning'
entries.key_risk: Post-hoc pattern matching on stochastic decay; no independent validation that step-states encode semantics; risk of apophenia
entries.next_experiment: Cross-validate against actual ASKAP J1832-0911 lightcurve data from Murphy et al. 2023; test if 'decoded' sequence survives permutation null model
entries.synthesizer_note: Narratively compelling but statistically fragile. The Bayesian decay model is mathematically sound, but the semantic mapping is arbitrary. Best treated as science-communication art, not empirical claim.

entries.title: Cantonese Quantum Bridge: Tonal Interference as Structural Filter for Mathematical Conjectures
entries.key_risk: No rigorous mapping between Cantonese phonology and complex analysis; 'phase cancellation' is metaphor without analytic correspondence; cannot derive testable prediction
entries.next_experiment: Attempt to formalize one concrete case: derive an explicit constraint on ζ(s) from a specific tonal interference rule that is mathematically equivalent to Re(s)=1/2 for at least one zero
entries.synthesizer_note: Rich structural metaphor with genuine aesthetic value. The 'helical lattice' intuition for zeta zeros is visually productive. However, the Cantonese bridge adds no mathematical rigor beyond metaphor. Collatz 'ground state' framing is elegant but non-constructive.

entries.title: Sonic Synthesis: H/T/D/A Signal Processing Pipeline for Fermi Void Analysis
entries.key_risk: Audio metaphor may not translate to actual signal processing algorithms; need concrete DSP implementation with defined filter banks, onset detection, and time-reversal operators
entries.next_experiment: Build prototype DSP chain in Python: generate synthetic 'void' noise, apply H-envelope, T-onset detection, D-stacking via multi-band spectrogram, A-flip via time-reversal + correlation analysis
entries.synthesizer_note: Most immediately actionable of the four. The H/T/D/A pipeline can be implemented as actual code today. Even if the Fermi interpretation is speculative, the DSP framework has standalone value as an anomaly detection architecture.

meta.title: Collection Integration: Fermi-Void Synthesis v2026.08.20
meta.collection_risk: J1832-0911 decoding and Quantum Bridge are Layer 3 mathematical fiction; integrating them alongside rigorous SETI methodology could dilute credibility of the Toolkit
meta.recommendation: Sandbox PASS for Toolkit (A) and Sonic Synthesis (B). Sandbox FAIL for J1832 decoding (C) and Quantum Bridge (D), but both retained as Layer 3 narrative/metaphor entries. Proceed with formalization of A and B, quarantine C and D in Layer 3 with explicit fiction tags.
